name.description: Flow display name, e.g. Send Form Submission Template

out.description: Write path for the import JSON. Optional.

languages.description: en/en_US only, ar only, or both. en and en_US are the same; Meta English locale is always en_US.

templates.description: Meta template names. en and en_US are aliases. Must include a key for every language.

sample.description: Data Gather sample. phone is required E.164. Both-language flows also need language.

params.description: Sample keys that fill body {{1}}, {{2}}, … in order
